disclosures.aoi_disclosure: Analysis AOI: the 10,000 m buffer around the dissolved union of 14 leases (1,380.85 km²; 1,534,281 cells at 30 m). The lease union is approximately 196.72 km² (14.25% of the AOI). Areas are 30 m cell-area equivalents, not surveyed or statutory areas; buffered-AOI percentages are not percentages of the lease union.
disclosures.hand_disclaimer: Flood-prone HAND screening proxy only; not a statutory flood extent, flood hazard map, or 0.5% AEP floodplain.
disclosures.tenure_vintage_caveat: Current geometry checks validate internal consistency, not tenure currency. QSpatial re-download and revalidation remain required before public or regulatory-framing use.
disclosures.generalisation_caveat: Curragh thresholds are NOT general defaults.
disclosures.known_s2_far_band_gradient: Known Sentinel-2 far-band regional gradient: approximately +0.025 at 2,000–5,000 m; inherited context, not a Phase 4 finding.
disclosures.same_year_state: Both same-year flag layers are zero and byte-identical; this shared layer cannot support sensor-specific same-year claims.
disclosures.catalog_note: Determinism is relative to the pinned catalog snapshot; OPEN:T2-CATALOG-METADATA-DRIFT remains. Metadata is not a scene-selection filter.

capacity.pooled_inference: Pooled primary inference rests on Landsat T1 complete-windows; Sentinel-2 is cluster-starved with insufficient_cohort_clusters at all floors.
capacity.2025_cohort_note: The 2025 cohort contributes 47,749 of 178,562 to the cited capacity figures; interpret capacity in that context.

fragility.interpretation: DHR/DLR trajectory-rate labels only; not rehabilitation quality or completion-criteria verdicts.
